Returned as SPARQL JSON bindings; LIMIT 5000 guards the service's 60-second execution ceiling rather than capping a result set that would otherwise be complete.|array_path=results.bindings;title_keys=itemLabel.value;id_keys=extid.value;header1=User-Agent: JapanOSINT-research/1.0 (+https://github.com/);interval=86400
